title: Disbursement
summary: DISBURSEMENT, noun Disbursment. 1. The act of paying out, as money from a public or private chest. 2. The money or sum paid out; as, the annual disbursements exceed the income.

inlines.v: DISBURSEMENT, noun Disbursment. 1. The act of paying out, as money from a public or private chest. 2. The money or sum paid out; as, the annual disbursements exceed the income.
